text: Finally! Protected bike lanes on Main Street. My kids might actually be able to ride to school without me panicking.
Great, so the city wants to take away 40 parking spots from small businesses that are barely hanging on. Brilliant plan.
The council votes on the Main Street bike lane proposal Thursday at 6pm. Public comment is open.

Fewer cars downtown means cleaner air. This is the easiest climate decision the council will ever get.
